optimizely-events: The public Event API schema defines these local contracts. Its default permissive processing mode can ignore unusable data; findings do not claim every invalid batch receives HTTP 400.
Project identity and campaign holdback requirements depend on the product in use and remain external. Explicit null experiment and variation decisions remain valid.
Array cardinality is not inferred. Custom event types and unknown properties remain open. U+E000-prefixed scalar strings are preserved.
Account identity, historic decision enrichment, UUID uniqueness, authorization and delivery require external context. The fixtures are schema-derived, not SDK-produced.
tiktok-browser: Pinned pixel.js 2.2.1 browser profile. All new checks remain warnings. Only analytics.tiktok.com/api/v2/pixel is claimed.
The same SDK emits JSON POST and unpadded UTF-8 Base64URL image fallbacks. Interaction, performance, onsite shop events and Events API are outside this browser profile.
Custom event names and array properties remain valid. External identity remains plain; only SDK email and phone wire hashes receive syntax checks. Currency syntax does not prove account support.
Hash syntax, account identity, consent, attribution, deduplication and delivery require external evidence.
The SDK retains uppercase prehashed email and phone values. Hash grammar is case insensitive and verified against an intercepted producer execution.
microsoft-clarity-collect: Pinned 0.8.49 producer and public TypeScript source profile. New checks remain warnings.

Plaintext JSON envelope fields and event-row prefixes are inspected. Future tuple members, event codes and replay payload tokens remain open. Older eight-member envelopes and empty cookieless identities remain accepted.

The SDK gzip transport uses a custom Accept header without Content-Encoding. Binary wire captures remain explicitly unvalidated by the existing core; no gzip magic sniffing or fake header is introduced.
Masking correctness, consent, replay semantics, project ownership and delivery require external context.
comscore-modern: Pinned beacon.js 4.14.0 configured browser profile. New checks remain warnings. cs_cfg selects it on sb.scorecardresearch.com/b and /b2.
The configuration can disable c7. SDK truncation can move c7 into ns_cut. Both remain valid without inheriting the legacy documented c7 requirement.
Client identity grammar remains opaque in the modern producer. Cookie values and truncation tails remain opaque.
Core privacy findings still apply. One denied synthetic TCF control deliberately omits its consent string and retains the core error. Consent validity, identity ownership and delivery are external.
comscore: The official legacy Direct c1=2, seven-digit c2 and c7 contract is retained. Configured SDK captures have a separate cs_cfg-selected pack.
Only optional SDK metadata is added as advisory. Receiver behavior on other beacon versions, account identity and delivery remain external.
google-analytics-collect: Pinned public Google tag source and offline query controls support advisory metadata checks. Existing GA4 identity requirements are retained.
Numeric epn and upn families accept signed decimal and scientific notation. String properties, custom events, consent encodings and proprietary product tuples remain open.
This is the browser query protocol, not the Measurement Protocol JSON API. Plaintext multi-event batch bodies are not claimed as parsed.
Property configuration, consent eligibility, attribution, identity, deduplication and delivery require external context.
stackadapt-pixel: The official server template sends GET and specific headers when gtm_ss=1. Blank source IP and User-Agent fallbacks remain valid.
Custom args properties remain open because the template forwards their configured values without a receiver schema. Browser requests do not inherit server header requirements.
Account ownership, consent, identity, conversion attribution and delivery need external context.

producer_controls.setup: Pinned unmodified public browser SDKs execute in Chromium with all traffic intercepted. The official StackAdapt server template executes with stubbed GTM modules. Only synthetic IDs, events and commerce data are used.

privacy: Only synthetic fixtures and public source metadata enter the product repository. Vendor SDK snapshots and historical corpus records remain outside it.
